entry.title: An interest in throwing needs a place
entry.summary: Davies responds to throwing by noticing patterns, protecting people and belongings, and finding an appropriate outlet for the movement.
entry.cue: Objects are being pushed from a table or thrown around the room.
detail: She describes moving vulnerable things out of reach and temporarily removing objects that could hurt when thrown—including wooden toys.
Her examples distinguish throwing outside from using soft things indoors. The underlying question is which movement the child is seeking and where it can happen within a clear limit.
